title: Ar / Billing Analyst
description: Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst Location: Remote (Brazil) About Sphise Technologies Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection. Position Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle. Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description: AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops. Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data. System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes. Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience. QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify\ "Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment. Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions. AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Ibm Ess Storage Support Engineer
description: We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues. Location: Brazil, Mexico Responsibilities: Provide day-to-day remote operational support for a 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations What we expect: Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE Working knowledge of the AIX command line Fluent English, both written and spoken Availability to work during EST business hours Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents Nice to have: Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments Background in data centre or scientific computing environments Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability Experience in incident management and root cause analysis We offer: Highly competitive compensation Flexible working hours Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs Strong management and tech expertise 12-month contract with possible extension

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota. What You’ll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Back End Developer
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions, creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams. increased automation coverage and reduced toil. Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests. Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability. Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention. SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor). What You Will Bring Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services. Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
Redis;
messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus. Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning. Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC. Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil. Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners. Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry. What You’ll Need Advanced skills in English Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting. Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry). Database performance engineering and query optimization. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Technical Implementation Specialist
description: Why Kodif? At Kodif, we’re transforming how customers interact with eCommerce brands. Superhuman Speed ⚡️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks. Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features. Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers. Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future. Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview: The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif’s customers to maximize the value of our platform. The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform. Responsibilities: Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals. Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed. Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans. Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams. Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents. Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities. Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention. Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis. Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements: Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX SaaS). Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required). Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly. Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers. Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools. Experience with LLM prompting. Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.G., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have: Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required). Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits: Competitive salary based on location and work experience. Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact. Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in eCommerce. title: Gerente De Testes
description:
Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso. O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança. Responsável por impulsionar práticas de teste consistentes e de alta qualidade em múltiplos projetos. A função garante um modelo de governança unificado, metodologias alinhadas e resultados de entrega previsíveis. Principais Responsabilidades - Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.
- Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.
- Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.
- Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste. Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.
- Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.
- Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.
- Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.
- Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.
- Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.
- Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente. Requisitos Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.
- Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.
- Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.
- Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.
- Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
- Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.
- Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.
- Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes. Experiência Desejáveis - Familiaridade com as plataformas SAP S/4HANA e Salesforce Lightning, incluindo módulos, aplicações e abordagens de entrega.
- Formação técnica com compreensão de integrações de sistemas e protocolos de interface.
- Experiência em planejamento e execução de testes de desempenho, carga e estresse.
- Forte experiência com modelos de entrega ágil e colaboração em equipes multifuncionais.
- Capacidade de análise de negócios, incluindo técnicas de levantamento e validação de requisitos.
- Experiência comprovada em TDD (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Testes).
- Experiência comprovada com Jira XRay, Selenium e Tricentis TTA

title: Solutions Architect

Key Responsibilities Solution & Data Architecture Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration). Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager

You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices. User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses. Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently. Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates. Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design. Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation. Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports. Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership. Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses. Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics. Education and/or experience Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce. 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team. Core competencies Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy. Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively. Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities. Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends. Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes. Benefits A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Especialista Key Account Internacional Latam (Mbrf Pet) - Morumbi Ou Campinas Sp
description: VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim! Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos. Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã. Atividades: Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio. - Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios. - Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada. - Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa. - Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão. - Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais. - Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado. - Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios. - Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades. - Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados. - Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente. - Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas. - Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada. Requisitos e qualificações - Graduação completa. - Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos. - Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios. - Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial. - Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas. - Domínio do Pacote Office. - CNH categoria B. - Disponibilidade para viagens. - Residir em Campinas ou arredores. Diferenciais: - Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos. - Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais. - Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado. - Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home) Contract Duration: 12 months Number of Open Positions: 20 Key Qualifications Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process - Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62136 as your email subject.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

Na Superlógica, você não precisa se moldar ao ambiente. Nós trabalhamos juntos para que o ambiente seja um lugar onde você possa ir longe, sendo exatamente como você é.

Sobre a Superlógica:

Nosso propósito é descomplicar e potencializar a relação das pessoas com suas casas, condomínios e vizinhança.

Somos a maior plataforma tecnológica, financeira e de crédito do mercado condominial, criando um ecossistema completo de soluções que facilitam a rotina de administradoras, síndicos, moradores e imobiliárias.

Também somos responsáveis pelo Superlógica Next, o maior evento condominial do país uma arena de debate sobre o futuro desse mercado.

Isso é ser Superlógica.
Isso é construir tecnologia com impacto real.

Em todas as decisões, usamos os nossos valores como bússola:

Somos feitos por pessoas que têm amor à educação Sobre nossa atuação

O Poliedro Educação tem mais de 30 anos de história e reúne três frentes de atuação: Sistema de Ensino, Colégio e Curso. Nosso compromisso é transformar a educação no Brasil, unindo inovação e excelência pedagógica.

Excelência nos direciona

title: Assistente Administrativo de Vendas
description:
Vaga de Assistente Administrativo de Vendas

Estamos em busca de um (a) Assistente Administrativo de Vendas, que venha fornecer suporte administrativo e operacional de excelência á equipe de vendas B2B, sendo o pilar de organização, agilidade e precisão para todos os processos comerciais;

Sua missão é otimizar o tempo dos Executivos (as) de contas e Key Account Managers, através da gestão eficiente de dados, documentação, comunicação e especialmente pela coordenação administrativa de processos licitatórios, garantindo a fluidez das operações, o cumprimento de requisitos e a satisfação do cliente, liberando a equipe de vendas para o foco estratégico no relacionamento e concretização de negócios;

Responsabilidades:

Suporte Administrativo e Operacional Direto à Equipe de vendas:

    Preparação de Materiais: Elaborar e formatar propostas, na ausência do Executivo (a) de contas e Key Account Manager ou quando necessário, organizar informações e outros documentos solicitados pela equipe de vendas, seguindo os padrões da empresa;

    Gestão de Documentação e Processos Comerciais:

    Elaboração e Revisão de Propostas e Contratos: Auxiliar com a elaboração de propostas comerciais e processos comerciais par exportação na ausência do Executivo de vendas e Key Account Manager ou quando necessário. Liderar a revisão de propostas comerciais garantindo a conformidade com as políticas internas e externas, a precisão das informações e a clareza da comunicação;

   Arquivo e Controle: Manter o arquivamento físico e digital de documentos comerciais organizado e atualizado, facilitando o acesso e rastreabilidade das informações;

   Follow-up de Processos: Realizar o acompanhamento de processos internos (confirmação de informações presentes no orçamento, emissão e liberação de pedidos, status de

     entrega) para garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e a comunicação proativa com a equipe de vendas;

Coordenação Administrativa de Processos Licitatórios:

Pesquisa e Monitoramento de Editais: Realizar a pesquisa proativa e sistemática de editais de licitação em portais públicos e privados, identificando oportunidades relevantes

para os produtos/serviços da empresa;

Análise Preliminar de Editais: Efetuar a leitura a análise preliminar dos editais, identificando requisitos administrativos, prazos, critérios de participação e a documentação

necessária, para subsidiar a decisão da equipe de vendas sobre a viabilidade de participação;

Organização e Checklist de Documentação: Preparar e manter um checklist detalhado da documentação exigida em cada edital. Coletar, organizar e verificar a validade de todos

os documentos administrativos (Certidões, declarações, comprovantes), garantindo a conformidade legal para a participação;

Suporte á Elaboração de Propostas: Auxiliar na compilação das informações técnicas e comerciais fornecidas pela equipe de vendas, garantindo que a proposta administrativa

esteja completa, organizada e dentro dos padrões exigidos pelo edital;

Acompanhamento de Prazos e Etapas: Monitorar os prazos de entrega de propostas, datas de abertura de envelopes e demais etapas do processo licitatório, comunicando as

informações críticas á equipe de vendas;

Manutenção de Base de Dados Licitatórios: Manter uma base de dados atualizada de licitações participadas, resultados, histórico de documentos e informações relevantes para

futuras concorrências;

Comunicação e Coordenação Interna e Externa:

Ponto focal de Comunicação: Atuar como um ponto de contato inicial para clientes e parceiros, direcionando solicitações e dúvidas para o membro da equipe de vendas

responsável, quando necessário;

Relação Interdepartamental: Facilitar a comunicação, e a troca de informações entre a equipe de vendas e outras áreas da empresa (financeiro, logística,marketing, pós-vendas,

jurídico), garantindo a agilidade na resolução de questões operacionais e suporte ao cliente;

Gestão de E-mails: Gerenciar caixas de e-mail compartilhadas ou de suporte, respondendo a perguntas rotineiras e encaminhando as demais, aos responsáveis;

O QUE BUSCAMOS:


  • Graduação completa: Ciências Contábeis, Economia e/ou Administração;
  • Habilidades de compreensão e organização de processos e fluxos de trabalho;
  • Visão holística da organização de processos contábeis e fiscais;
  • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para interação eficaz;
  • Experiência em elaboração, manipulação de planilhas e processos contábeis;


COMO SERÁ O PROCESSO?


Assim como no processo de criação de um festival, no processo seletivo da Feel Alive você também precisa passar por algumas etapas para alcançar o tão sonhado SIM.


  • Preenchimento completo de cadastro na Gupy;
  • Bate-papo com o time de Gente & Gestão;
  • Bate-papo com a liderança da área;
  • Envio de documentações e proposta.


Nossa expectativa de início já é para o primeiro semestre de 2026, por isso, segue a lista de etapas do processo seletivo, quanto antes concluir, mais rápido entraremos em contato.

Suas responsabilidades como Analista de Controladoria serão:


  • Calcular e fechar valores para emissão de notas fiscais (Fee e BV);
  • Emitir notas fiscais e notas de débito conforme legislação vigente Formô e verticais B2B;
  • Conferir e auditar lançamentos fiscais e intercompany (mútuos/conta corrente);
  • Apoiar demandas regulatórias e administrativas relacionadas à área fiscal, quando aplicável;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar a contabilidade externa nas rotinas mensais, trimestrais e anuais;
  • Renovação de certificados digitais;
  • Enviar, organizar e validar documentos contábeis e fiscais;
  • Gerar, controlar e acompanhar guias de impostos e seus vencimentos;
  • Receber, conferir e organizar demonstrativos contábeis (Balanço, DRE, DFC e DMPL) elaborados pela contabilidade externa;
  • Monitorar mensalmente o volume de faturamento por empresa e vertical para fins fiscais (incluindo Cena 5);
  • Gerenciar e realizar a manutenção do banco de contratos de projetos;
  • Garantir organização, rastreabilidade e conformidade das informações fiscais e contábeis;
  • Validar estoques e ativos relevantes de forma periódica;
  • Apoiar em auditoria interna financeira e análises de conformidade;
  • Reconciliação contábil e atividades similares.

Mesmo que não exista uma vaga aberta no momento, este banco é o primeiro lugar onde buscamos novos talentos quando surgem oportunidades. Se você busca crescimento profissional, desafios reais e impacto nos resultados de negócio, esse banco é pra você.
